name: command
title: Command
description: Manga-styled command palette (cmdk). The palette is a case (3px ink line, tone shadow) with a search row drawn like an input with a search mark and a 2px line under it. Group headings are underlined lettering; the highlighted item inverts to an ink flat; the chosen item gets a brush check; disabled items keep the label with a dashed underline. Shortcuts are mono lettering in a fine frame. CommandDialog pops in over three steps, and its case is the palette itself. Empty state uses a “…” mark. Gestures: G1 case, G2 flat, G3 hover inversion, G5 pop, G8 check.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/command". It wraps your own components/ui/command (cmdk), so the stock command and cmdk are installed with it. CommandDialog uses the manga Dialog around the stock Command.

meta.tagline: A notched case of commands: the highlighted row inverts to ink.
meta.usage:
import { Command, CommandDialog, CommandEmpty, CommandGroup, CommandInput, CommandItem, CommandList, CommandShortcut } from "@/components/ui/manga/command"

<Command>
  <CommandInput placeholder="Search chapters…" />
  <CommandList>
    <CommandEmpty>No page matches.</CommandEmpty>
    <CommandGroup heading="Read">
      <CommandItem value="chapter-12">
        Chapter 12 — The rooftop
        <CommandShortcut>1</CommandShortcut>
      </CommandItem>
    </CommandGroup>
  </CommandList>
</Command>

props.name: CommandDialog
props.description: The palette in a dialog (open, onOpenChange, title, description). The dialog frame is hidden: the palette draws the case.

props.name: CommandInput
props.description: The search row: a search mark, an input in the reading face, a 2px line under it.

props.name: CommandEmpty
props.description: Shown when nothing matches: a “…” mark and a short line (children override the text).

props.name: CommandItem
props.description: An option. disabled keeps the label with a dashed underline; data-checked="true" shows the brush check.

props.name: CommandShortcut
props.description: A shortcut in mono lettering inside a fine frame, at the end of an item.
